Privacy

Privacy Policy

This page explains what information StandPoint receives through this website, how it is used, and how you can contact us about it.

Information we collect How we use it Cookies & analytics Service providers Retention Your requests Contact

Information we collect

We collect information that you choose to send us through the enquiry forms and contact details on this website. Depending on what you submit, this may include:

  • name
  • company name
  • email address
  • phone number
  • exhibition and project information, such as the show, stand size or floor plan
  • the content of your message
  • files you upload, such as drawings, floor plans or brand materials
  • technical website usage information through Google Analytics, but only where you have given analytics consent

We do not ask for special categories of personal data, and there is no need to include them in an enquiry.

How we use it

Information submitted through the website is used to:

  • respond to enquiries
  • communicate with potential and existing clients
  • prepare quotations and proposals
  • work on exhibition stand projects
  • improve the website
  • understand website usage and traffic

We do not sell personal information, and we do not pass it to third parties for their own marketing.

Cookies and analytics

The website uses Google Analytics 4 to understand how visitors use the site — for example which pages and portfolio projects are viewed. Analytics is loaded only after you select “Accept” in the cookie notice. If you select “Necessary only”, the analytics script is not loaded and no analytics cookies are set.

Advertising and personalisation storage remain switched off in all cases; we do not run advertising or remarketing on this website.

You can change your choice at any time with the Cookie settings link in the footer of every page.

Service providers

Technical service providers may process information on our behalf where it is necessary to run the website, namely for website hosting, delivery of contact-form enquiries, and website analytics. They process the information only to provide those services.

Retention

Enquiry correspondence and project materials are kept for as long as they are needed for the enquiry or project, and for our ordinary business records afterwards. Analytics data is retained according to the settings of our Google Analytics property.

Access, correction and deletion

You may contact us at any time to ask what personal information we hold about you, to have it corrected, or to have it deleted. Write to our.team@standpoint-expo.com and we will respond to your request.
